acquisition: The mass spectrometric analysis was conducted on an LTQ Orbitrap Lumos (Thermo Fisher Scientific) based nanoLCMS system.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses an Auxin-Induced Degron (AID) system to achieve acute protein depletion, which is functionally equivalent to a conditional knockout/deletion for the purpose of the proteomics comparison. The MS analysis specifically targets the Nuclear Pore-enriched fraction (NPCCF) to compare the proteome in the absence or presence of auxin for different AID-tagged nucleoporins.
